data.name: Mawforged
data.detailed_description:
Step into Mawforged, a first-person survival RPG set in a world fractured by ancient wars among gods and mortals. Guide a resilient dwarf through the Maw, a mysterious realm filled with layered biomes, primal dangers, and dark secrets. Survive harsh environments, craft essential tools, and uncover the profound story waiting in the shadows.
This epic tale forged by the Gods has begun; now it’s your turn to embark on this journey and discover what remains. 

Dive into the Maw with your first steps: learn the basics of survival, combat, and crafting to adapt to the ever-changing challenges of this dark realm. Master powerful swordplay and tactical decisions to defend or attack the threats you’ll face. Explore layered biomes rich with resources and hidden lore that deepen the experience. Connect with fellow adventurers, share strategies, and stay updated by joining our growing community.

  • Intense first-person swordplay and tactical combat

  • Rich, layered biomes with diverse environments and primal dangers

  • Craft weapons and essential tools to survive and conquer

  • Dynamic survival mechanics, including a hunger system to manage

  • Character progression and evolution are driven by an immersive story

  • Strategic exploration and resource management in a challenging world

  • Unlock new abilities, technologies, and upgrades

  • Immerse yourself in the deep lore with unique history, culture, and ambitions

Become part of Mawforged’s growing community. Wishlist on Steam, connect with us on Discord, and follow our socials for exclusive updates, developer insights, and behind-the-scenes content. Your support helps shape the future of the game. Thank you for joining us on this journey!

data.short_description: Mawforged is a first-person action RPG set in a dark fantasy world shaped by myth and magic. Master intense swordplay, tactical combat, and immersive exploration as you craft, survive, and unveil an epic story forged by ancient gods. Adventure awaits within the Maw.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit build 1909.1350 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-Bit Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 9700 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
